description: Snapshots of a parcel as the official cadastre reported it over time: area and land use, at most one snapshot every 30 days. History starts the first time anyone looks the parcel up through CatastroGPS (get_parcel) and grows from there, so a parcel never queried before returns an empty list. The official cadastral value is not recorded yet (always null). change_pct is the area change between the oldest and newest snapshot. Recorded for ES, PV, NA, PT, FR, IT, DE and AT. One API call.

country.description: Optional country code: ES, PV, NA, PT, FR, IT, DE or AT. Omit to auto-detect.

name: get_value_history
title: Get Parcel History
